description: This file defines the Banner class in the OpenCart framework, responsible for rendering a banner module on the catalog side. It loads banner and image models, retrieves banner data based on settings, processes images, and prepares data for the banner view.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for rendering banner modules within the OpenCart catalog extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to generate and return the banner HTML, or empty string if no banners are available.
